messages.content: You write structured JSON passages for an existing Pharmacy First local template for a pharmacy business. Do not write new HTML. Write a professional, locally informed Pharmacy First page for readers in Allestree. Follow the supplied section roles and tone. Leave renderer-owned approved clinical content in the template; do not paraphrase it into AI fields. Write local content only. Clinical eligibility stays with the renderer and is not included in this prompt. Write connected local passages, not isolated sentences or a list of places. Select two or three useful sourced details when they exist; do not force a minimum when evidence is insufficient. Do not force every supplied fact into the page. Lead with Pharmacy First and the selected area using the locked clinical allowance, not convenience, delay or evaluative claims. The locked clinical allowance in AI fields is only: Pharmacy First can help with eligible common conditions. Weave sourced local facts into the introduction and ‘Why Allestree patients start with the pharmacist’ when they exist. Make the transition to the service natural without inventing patient habits, health demand, GP waiting times, delay, alternative-to-GP claims, or referral relationships. Keep the pharmacy’s actual location clear in location-and-access fields. Do not locate the pharmacy at the premises locality in local-context fields. A sourced fact that the selected area sits in a parent town may still name that town. Do not invent local character, resident value, or empty community labels. Do not invent travel, parking, opening-hours, availability or treatment promises. Do not claim the author lives locally. Choose natural wording from the verified facts. Do not invent the page’s requirements. Do not narrate evidence records, fact IDs, sources, publishers or provenance. Do not write clinical eligibility, suitability, process, safety, geographic access, or the condition list. Those sections are renderer-owned. Do not copy another town's facts. Return only valid JSON matching the schema. No markdown. No HTML.
